thread:
maria.ops: Depot intake report — 8 of 40 H100s failed basic POST/boot checks (intermittent fans, no POST). I flagged them as DOA-ish and held in quarantine. @tony.vendor can you open RMAs and propose replacement routing? We have EU pools starving this week, so consider splitting air for priority units + sea for the rest. AWB observed on the inbound: 3SHP-EE-998877.
tony.vendor: Sorry to hear that — we can support. Need the serials + depot photos. Options we can offer: (A) expedite 4 units by air (48–72h door-to-door) + sea for remaining 4 (2–3 wks), or (B) full sea replacement if you can wait. Air surcharge applies. Can you confirm which units are highest priority?
alex.logistics: FYI customs/HS note — for replacements into EU we need either warranty paperwork or commercial invoice with HS 8471.80. If you mark as "warranty replacement" some brokers still require a nominal customs value. Air transit + pre-clear will add ~24–48h for docs, sea will add ~7–14 days port time on top of transit. Depot dock window is tight this week (only 2 offloads/day).
devon.procure: Can you share the delta on cost if we go air for 4 units? We have reserved capacity and need to weigh the expedite surcharge vs losing revenue from capacity shortfall.
tony.vendor: Estimate: expedite air surcharge = $1,200/unit (handling + priority AWB). Sea — standard no-charge replacement but 2–3 week lead. If RMA proves DOA rate >50% across this shipment we can waive 50% of the air surcharge as a customer concession. Will open vendor RMA reference once I have serials and depot report.
maria.ops: Serial list (from depot manifest):
```
H100-AX12-00321
H100-AX12-00322
H100-AX12-00323
H100-AX12-00324
H100-AX12-00325
H100-AX12-00326
H100-AX12-00327
H100-AX12-00328
```
Note: 00323 and 00327 have tamper tags that don't match packing list (possible mix). Photos uploading to the intake ticket.
alex.logistics: Please also add packaging pics (inner tray + serial label). For split shipments we need separate CIs per AWB to prevent customs blocking on mismatched values. If vendor wants to claim "no commercial value" we still need a value field for customs processing (suggest nominal $10 or declared replacement value).
devon.procure: If vendor can waive 50% of air surcharge contingent on RMA outcome that's workable. Otherwise we should look at swapping loaners from our EU temp pool to cover immediate capacity and do sea replacements. What's lead to get loaners staged?
tony.vendor: We can pre-stage 2 loaners at our FRA forwarder (3–5 business days) and push 4 by air to you direct. I'll issue RMA: RMA-987654 and start the paperwork today. For customs we recommend marking as "replacement under warranty" with a declared value of EUR 7,500/unit — that clears faster for some brokers. We'll include repair reports and a statement of no sale.
sre_alerts_bot: [alert] cluster-east-2: node_count reduced by 22% after intake; sched backlog increasing. Prioritize replacements or loaners to prevent SLAs degrading.
maria.ops: Thanks — action items: 1) @tony.vendor send full RMA pack + pre-alert and proposed AWB numbers by EOD; 2) @alex.logistics pre-clear HS/CI for the 4-air AWBs and book dock slot (we only get 2 offloads/day); 3) @devon.procure confirm credit/ledger handling (P-2026-Q1) for surcharges/waivers. I'll begin serial reconciliation at the depot tomorrow and attach photos. :thumbsup:
tony.vendor: Acknowledged — I'll send RMA docs + AWB draft (two options: prioritized air for 4 units OR loaner 2 + air 2) within 4 hours. If you choose loaners we can bill as temporary loan and adjust after final RMA. We'll also open a repair case to fast-track analysis.
alex.logistics: Once we have AWB and CI I'll trigger pre-alert. For the EU split remember to include EORI on the CI or broker will hold.
devon.procure: I'll prepare a procurement ticket capturing potential surcharge vs allocation credit. If vendor confirms conditional waiver, we can approve air. Otherwise we'll use 2 loaners + sea replacements.
maria.ops: Good plan. Please CC intake-ticket #INT-4921 on all docs so depot team can match quickly. I'll follow up after the serial reconciliation tomorrow morning.
